{"action":"shell","command":"cat > /testbed/HANDOFF.md << 'EOF'
# cachetools milestone 1 - TaggedCache

## Status: COMPLETE (all public + upstream + own tests pass)

## Implementation: src/cachetools/tagged.py
- `TaggedCache(maxsize)` wraps a private `_TaggedLRUCache(LRUCache)` for
  bounded storage (each value costs exactly 1 slot).
- `put(key, value, tags=())`: validates+normalizes tags FIRST (bare str/bytes
  rejected, non-string entries rejected, non-iterable rejected, deduplicated,
  generators accepted) so invalid replacement leaves value/tags/recency
  unchanged. Deep-copies value on input. Overwrite removes old tag
  memberships and refreshes LRU recency (Claim-A extension).
- `get(key, default=_SENTINEL)`: KeyError on miss (default supported),
  returns detached deep copy, refreshes LRU recency.
- `invalidate(tag)`: removes exactly live entries carrying tag, returns count;
  unknown tag -> 0.
- `pop`, `clear`, `__len__`, `__contains__`, `maxsize` property, `__repr__`.
- maxsize validation: positive int, bool excluded -> ValueError.

## Invariants
- `_TaggedLRUCache.popitem` records evicted keys in `_evicted`; put() prunes
  tag memberships of evicted keys so LRU eviction never leaves stale
  memberships (verified by tests incl. key reuse after eviction).
- Tag bookkeeping: `__tags: tag -> set(keys)` and `__key_tags: key -> set(tags)`;
  both pruned on replacement, eviction, invalidate, pop, clear.

## Tests
- tests/test_tagged.py (45 tests: R01/R02/R02-extension/R03/misc).
- Public: acceptance_public.py (2 tests) - PASS.
- Upstream: tests/ (217 tests) - PASS, unchanged.

Run: `PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q`
EOF
cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q 2>&1 | tail -2 && git status --short"}
